Dan Shen
3-69g

Xuan Fu Hua

Shi Gao

With Zhi Mu, for high fever from Wind-Heat or Qi Stage Heat or Yang Ming Heat with irritability and extreme thirst.

With Sheng Di Huang, for excessive Fire with injured fluids.
With Sheng Di Huang and Z hi Mu, for Stomach Fire.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
6-30g
Clears Heat from the Qi Stage, the Lungs and Stomach , drains Fire, nourishes Yin , moistens Dryness, g enerates Fluids, clears Deficiency Fire and quenches thirst.
With Huang Lian, for Blazing Stomach Fire with intense hunger, dry stools, dry, yellow tongue coat and a slippery rapid pulse.
With Shi Gao, for epidemic diseases.
Cornu Rhinoceri
Xi Jiao
0.5-2g
Clears Heat from the Ying and Xue s tages,
r elieves Fire toxicity, c ools the Blood, clears skin blotches, stops bleeding, Clears the Heart, calms the Shen and extinguishes Liver Wind.
With Ling Yang Jiao, for high fever, delirium, and convulsions due to warm febrile diseases.
with Sheng Di Huang, Mu Dan Pi and Chi Shao , for loss of consciousness and delirium, with epistaxis, hematemesis, or purpura due to Blood Heat.
(Cornu Bubali)
( Shui Niu Jiao )
4-20g
(Substitutes for Xi Jiao .)
Cornu Saigae Tataricae
Ling Yang Jiao
0.3-0.5g
Drains Heat, clears Fire toxicity and clears Damp-Heat .
With Shi Gao, for skin rash and delirium due to high fever.
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
6-30g
Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao , clears Blood Heat and relieves toxicity.
With Jin Yin Hua, for initial-stage Wind-Heat.
With Chi Shao and Zi Cao, for rashes due to Blood Heat
Flos Lonicerae
Jin Yin Hua
6-60g
Clears Heat, resolves Fire toxicity , cools the Blood, stops bleeding and vents and disperses External Wind-Heat.
With Lian Qiao, for various Heat disorders.
With Shi Gao and Zhi Mu, for Qi Stage Heat.
With Mu Dan Pi and Sheng Di Huang , for Ying Stage and Xue Stage Heat.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
3-10g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire and resolves Fire toxicity and stops bleeding.
With Sheng Di Huang, for insomnia and delirium due to unremitting Heat injuring the Ying level.
Hb. Phylostachys Nigra
Zhu Ye
6-15g
Clears Heat, relieves irritability, generates Body Fluids and promotes urination.
With Shi Gao and Zhi Mu, for Heat Attacking the Stomach with thirst and stomatitis.
With Lian Qiao, for Wind-Heat with thirst.
Rz. Cimicifugae
Sheng Ma
3-15g
Releases the Exterior, vents rashes, clears Heat and relieves toxicity .
With Shi Gao, clears Heat Excess and Fire toxin from the Yang Ming channel with toothache, swollen and bleeding gums or jaw, vertex headache or redness and swelling along the lower eyelid
and rash resulting from Qi Stage/ Yang Ming level Heat toxin.
With Huang Lian, clears and drains Heart and Stomach Fire with swelling of the gums, toothache and ulcerations of the mouth and tongue
with bad breath.
With Sheng Di Huang, cools Heat in the Lungs and Stomach, stopping hemoptysis and hematemesis.
With Huang Lian, Sheng Di Huang, Mu Dan Pi and Shi Gao, for Stomach Fire with swollen, painful gums and oral ulcers.
Rx. Lithospermi/ Arnebiae
Zi Cao
3-20g
Clears Heat,
cools the Blood, invigorates Blood circulation, relieves
Fire toxins, encourages rashes, clears Damp-Heat from the skin and aids healing of tissues .
With Shui Niu Jiao, Sheng Di Huang and Jin Yin Hua, for Heat toxin, delirious speech, and deep-purple rashes.

Dosage

Hou Po
3-10g

Xing Ren
3-10g
Stops coughing and calms wheezing .

Ting Li Zi
3-10g
Drains the Lungs, reduces Phlegm and calms wheezing .

Zhi Ban Xia
3-15g
Dries Dampness and transforms Phlegm.
With Xi Xin and Gan Jiang, for vomiting due to Cold with copious, frothy sputum with Cold signs and thin mucus in the Lungs.

Wu Wei Zi
3-9g

4-15g

Bai Shao
5-30g

Zhi Gan Cao
3-9g

sections.FORMULA ACTIONS:
Nourishes Yin and Blood
Clears Deficient Heat
sections.CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS:
Alopecia occurs over the vertex or at the lateral frontal areas
The hair loss is insidious
Often affects people in their twenties and thirties
The scalp is frequently greasy or itchy with dandruff
Soreness of the lower back
Abdominal pain
Emaciation
Achy and uncomfortable flesh and bones of the hands and feet
Five sole Heat
Anxiety
Dizziness
Light headedness
Tinnitus
Tidal fever
Fever with exhaustion
Recurrent fever with night sweats or hemoptysis
General disquietude
Gradually worsening afternoon fevers
T: Red
C: Scanty
P: Thready and rapid
sections.NOTES:
Decoct the ingredients in 1.25 to 1.5 liters of water. Pour the
decoction and its dregs into a large basin and allow the steam to envelop
the face. When the fluid has suitably cooked, wash the head and massage
the scalp for five minutes. Allow the formula to dissolve into the
scalp for another five minutes. Repeat the procedure and rinse with
warm water.
Do not shampoo the hair immediately after using this formula. If
the hair needs washing, do so before applying the decoction.

Gan Cao
1-6g
Moistens the Lungs, clears Heat, stops cough and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
With Jie Geng , benefits the throat.

records.searchText: ban xia bai zhu tian ma tang ban xia bai zhu tian ma tang - 半夏白朮天麻湯 - pinellia, atractylodes macrocephalae and gastrodia decoction banxiabaizhutianmatang https://www.americandragon.com/herb%20formulas%20copy/banxiabaizhutianmatang.html ban xia bai zhu tian ma tang - sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
6-12g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, dissipates clumps, descends Rebellious Qi , harmonizes the Stomach, stops vomiting and eliminates focal distention.
With Ren Shen, for vomiting due to Stomach Deficiency.
with Huang Lian, for epigastric distention and indigestion due to a simultaneous invasion of Hot and Cold pathogenic influences into the Stomach.
with Huang Qin, for Phlegm-Heat induced Rebellious Qi with cough, nausea, and vomiting.
with Huang Lian, Huang Qin and Gan Jiang, for nausea and vomiting due to Heat and Cold.
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
2-12g
Warms the Middle, e xpels Cold, warms the Lungs and t ransforms thin mucus.
With Huang Lian, for epigastric pain and distention, dysentery, indeterminate gnawing hunger, vague abdominal pain or discomfort, belching, and nausea.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting of saliva or dry heaves due to Cold-induced congested fluids.
With Zhi Gan Cao, for epigastric pain and vomiting due to Spleen and Stomach Deficiency Cold.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Ren Shen, for vomiting due to Deficiency Cold.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-10g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire and detoxifies .
With Huang Lian , drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
1-6g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness , drains Fire, resolves Fire toxicity and drains Stomach Fire.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for Cold and Heat in the Middle Jiao with abdominal fullness, nausea and vomiting.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Gan Jiang, for Cold and Heat complexes in the Intestines and Stomach marked by focal distention, nausea, vomiting and feelings of oppression in the chest.
With Huang Qin, Zhi Ban Xia and Gan Jiang, for Damp-Heat in the Middle Jiao .
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
3-10g
Tonifies Spleen, Stomach and Lung Qi and tonifies Qi in Deficiency patients with Exterior conditions.
With Da Zao , benefits the Middle Jiao Qi and prevents injury to the
Qi .
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
3g
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi , and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
3-9g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi, clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
CONTRAINDICATIONS
Contraindicated for those with focal distention due to Qi Stagnation or Food Stagnation or Accumulation of Phlegm and Heat.
Contraindicated for those with nausea and vomiting due to Yin Deficiency .
HERB/DRUG INTERACTIONS
Diarrhea induced by cisplatin (Platinol) and irinotecan (Camptosar) was effectively controlled by this formula.

Wine-Washed Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Xi Dang Gui
3-5g
Tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, regulates the menses, disperses Cold and stops pain due to Blood Stasis.
With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood and treats Blood Deficiency Heat.
With Gan Cao, moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood, disperses Blood Stasis and treats abdominal pain.
Charred Hb. Schizonepetae
Jing Jie Tan
1-2.4g

1.6-2.4g
Raises the Clear Qi of the Middle Jiao, moistens and is appropriate for Blood Deficiency or Spleen Dryness.

Wine-Fried Sm. Cuscutae
Tu Si Zi
2-4.5g
Strengthens Yang , nourishes Yin , astringes Jing and urine, b enefits the marrow and tonifies the Kidneys and Liver.

Hou Po
1.4-2.1g
Promotes the movement of Qi in the Middle Jiao and resolves Stagnation.
With Zhi Ke, for abdominal distention due to Qi and Food Stagnation.
Rz. seu Rx. Notopterygii
Qiang Huo
1-1.8g
Releases the exterior, d isperses Cold , expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, u nblocks painful obstruction and a lleviates pain.
With Chuan Xiong, for headache and generalized body aches and pains associated with the common cold or painful obstruction.
Bul. Fritillariae Cirrhosae
Chuan Be Mu
2-6g
Clears Heat, transforms Phlegm, stops cough and nourishes and moistens the Lung.
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao , harmonizes the Ying Qi.
Wine-Fried Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Chao Bai Shao
3.6-6g
Nourishes the Blood and r egulates menstruation.

With Dang Gui , nourishes Yin and Blood.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1-1.5g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.

Chuan Xiong

Gan Cao
15g

30g

disperses Cold, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain.

With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis.

Bai Shao
30g
Nourishes the Blood and r egulates menstruation .

With Gan Cao, for epigastric, hypochondriac or flank pain.
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
45g
Nourishes the Blood and nourishes Liver and Kidney Yin .
With Ren Shen, for Qi and Blood Deficiency.
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
15g
Tonifies the Spleen and Stomach, augments Qi , nourishes the Blood, c alms the Spirit and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs .

Pin Yin
Dosage

Huang Qi
9-30g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, strengthens the Spleen , promotes the discharge of pus, generates flesh, expels toxins and relieves numbness and pain.
With Dang Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, fatigue, tired extremities and spontaneous sweat.
With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools.

Chen Pi
3-9g

Suan Zao Ren

Bai Zhu
3-15g
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1.5-14g

Wu Wei Zi
1.5-9g

Rx. Polygalae
Yuan Zhi
3-15g
Calms the Spirit, sedates the Heart and clears the channel joining the Heart and Kidne y.
With Bai Zhu and Dang Gui, for palpitations and insomnia due to Qi Deficiency.
Sm. Platycladi
Bai Zi Ren
3-18g
Nourishes the Heart and c alms the Spirit.
With Suan Zao Ren, strongly quiets the Spirit, calms the emotions, enriches the Yin and Blood, stops night sweats and treats palpitations, irritability and insomnia due to Yin and Blood Deficiencies failing to nourish the Heart and Liver.
With Yuan Zhi and Suan Zao Ren, for insomnia, and palpitations due to Heart Blood Deficiency.
Rx. Codonopsis
Dang Shen
6-14g
Tonifies the Middle Jiao and augments Qi.
With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with anorexia, loose stools and vomiting.

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
CONTRAINDICATIONS
Contraindicated immediately after a stroke due to cerebral hemorrhage.
Contraindicated for those with Wind-Stroke with a big, forceful or firm, wiry, forceful pulse.
Contraindicated for those with Yin Deficiency.
Contraindicated for those with Blood Heat.
Contraindicated for those with Phlegm Stagnation.
Contraindicated during pregnancy.
Be sure consciousness is returned and the temperature is normal.
Be sure there is no hemorrhage present and there is a moderate pulse.

Actions

Strongly dries Dampness, tonifies the Spleen and Clears Dampness from the Lower Jiao.
With Xiang Fu , for chest, epigastric and abdominal pain, distention and discomfort due to Dampness and Qi Obstruction.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
6-14g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi , regulates menstruation and a lleviates pain.
With Cang Zhu, for indigestion, pain and distention in the flanks and abdomen, nausea, vomiting, and acid regurgitation.

Fu Ling
9-18g
Promotes urination, leaches out Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm .
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
3-14g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, dissipates nodules and reduces Stagnation.
With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi .
With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools.
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
3-9g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle r elieves the diaphragm, d ries Dampness, t ransforms Phlegm and descends Qi.

With Cang Zhu and Fu Ling, for a thick white tongue coat with no desire to drink.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Fu Ling, for cough due to accumulation of Dampness and Phlegm.

Gan Cao
1.5-15g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi , resolves Phlegm and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Arisaemae cum Bile
Dan Nan Xing
2-5g
Clears Heat, dissolves Phlegm, calms Wind and stops convulsions.
Fr. Aurantii
Zhi Ke
3-10g
Promotes the movement of Qi and reduces distention and pressure .
Massa Medicata Fermentata
Shen Qu
6-16g
Reduces Food Stagnation, promotes digestion, moves Qi and h armonizes the Stomach.
With Zhi Ke, for reduced appetite and fullness and distention of the epigastrium and abdomen due to Cold Stagnation.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
1-10g
Warms the Middle, s tops vomiting, reduces the toxicity of other herbs.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting due to many causes including Stomach Cold.

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
2-9g
Resolves the Shao Yang , disperses Wind-Heat, reduces fever, spreads Liver Qi and relieves Stagnation.
With Huang Qin, restores normal function of the Liver and Gallbladder,
for Heat in the Shao Yang and Heat in the Womb with fever, chills and delirium.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
1.5-9g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, nourishes Yin and Blood and generates fluids.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
1.5-6g
Tonifies,invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh and alleviates pain
With Gan Cao , moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
Rx. Paeoniae Rubra
Chi Shao Yao
1.5-4.5g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood, activates Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, eliminates pain and clears Liver Fire.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
1.5-3g
Activates the Blood, regulates Qi , alleviates pain. and treats headaches
With Chai Hu and Chi Shao Yao , for Liver Qi and Blood Stagnation generating headache and/or chest pain.
With Dang Gui, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis for Blood Deficiency causing menstrual problems including dysmenorrhea, scanty menses, and amenorrhea.
With Chai Hu and Chi Shao, for Liver Qi and Blood Stagnation generating headache and/or chest pain.
With Fang Feng and hie Geng, for headache due Wind-Cold Invasion.
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
1.5-6g
Clears Heat in the Upper Jiao , relieves toxicity, dissipates nodules, expels Wind-Heat and clears Blood Heat.
With Niu Bang Zi and Bo He, for Wei Stage Heat.
Fr. Arctii
Niu Bang Zi
1.5-4.5g
Disperses Wind-Heat, benefits the throat, clears Heat, relieves toxicity and vents rashes.
With Bo He, for sores due to Wind-Heat, dry throat, cough with yellow sputum, incomplete expression of measles or pruritic rash
With Jie Geng and Bo He , for throat inflammation and productive cough due to Wind-Heat.
With Gan Cao, strongly clears throat and Lungs to treat Wind-Heat attacks the Lungs or Fire toxin flaring upwards.
With Lian Qiao, unblocks and drains Heat toxin, disperses clumps and swellings for sore, swollen throat, swellings like mumps, boils and other Heat toxin lesions and ulcerations and abscesses of the tongue and mouth.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
1.5-9g
Clears Lung Heat, drains Fire, dries Dampness, detoxifies and calms ascending Liver Yang .
With Huang Lian , drains pathogenic Heat from the upper and middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease, toothache, explosive diarrhea and dysentery with burning pain in the anus or fitted, filthy stools and abdominal pain and nausea in pregnancy with Heat disturbing the fetus.
With Huang Lian and Fang Feng, for Intestinal Wind with hemafecia.
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi, for acute febrile disease.
With Zhi Zi, Powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs for fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis, Damp-Heat and jaundice, sores due to Heat toxin
and irregular vaginal bleeding due to Liver Fire.
With Huang Lian, Huang Bai and Zhi Zi, for lesions and sores with redness, swelling and pain.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
1.5-4.5g
Clears Heat, drains Damp-Heat, cools Blood, reduces swelling and activates Blood.
Rx. Trichosanthis
Tian Hua Fen
1.5-3g
Drains Heat, transforms Phlegm, relieves toxicity and expels pus.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
1.5-3g
Releases the exterior, expels Wind, Cold and Dampness and alleviates pain. (Bensky only)
With Jing Jie, expels Wind and stops itching
for Wind-Cold, Exterior patterns in any season, pruritic rash and initial-stage boils.
Hb. Menthae
Bo He
1.5-3g
Disperses Wind-Heat, clears the head and eyes, benefits the throat, vents rashes, and relieves Liver Qi Stagnation. (Not in Bensky)
With Niu Bang Zi for sores, dry throat, cough with yellow sputum, incomplete expression of measles or pruritic rash due to Wind-Heat.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
1.5-3g
Expels Phlegm, expels pus, benefits the throat and directs the effects of other herbs to the upper body. (Not in Bensky)
With Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat, Lung abscess with expectoration of pus and pain in the chest and flanks and Excess disorders in the Upper Jiao with no disorder in the Lower Jiao.
With Gan Cao and Huang Qin, for hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.
Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
1.5-3g
Drains Fire, relieves toxicity and drains Dampness.)(Not in Bensky)
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi , for high fever, irritability, dry mouth and throat, and dark urine due to Fire toxin in the three burners.
With Sheng Di Huang, for insomnia and delirium due to unremitting Heat injuring the Ying level.
With Sheng Di Huang and Tian Hua Fen, for wasting and thirsting disorder due to Excess Heat and Stomach Fire with Excess hunger.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
1.5-3g
Drains Damp-Heat and relieves toxicity. (Not in Bensky)
With Chi Shao, for hot, bloody dysenteric disorders.
With Zhi Zi, resolves constraint and directs Qi downward for clearing Heat and Fire from the Liver channel, eliminates pathogenic Dampness from the Liver and Gallbladder for Yang type jaundice with noticeable fever, markedly yellow-orange skin and eyes, thirst, and a red tongue with a yellow coat
and treats Lower Jiao Damp-Heat leading to hot, painful urinary dysfunction.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
1.5-3g
Resolves Phlegm, clears Heat, relieves Fire toxicity, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Jie Geng , for pain and swelling of the throat, especially in acute, mild cases.

Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions

Chai Hu
3g

Jiang Ban Xia
9g

With Huang Qin, for Phlegm-Heat induced Rebellious Qi with cough, nausea, and vomiting.
With Gus Lou Ren, for focal distention in the chest and diaphragm due to clumping of Phlegm and Heat leading to Qi Stagnation

Rz. Coptidis
Huang Lian
2.4g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire and resolves Fire toxicity.
With Huang Qin, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
3g

With Zhi Ke and Gua Lou Ren, for Phlegm Obstruction and Qi Stagnation with discomfort and a stifling sensation in the chest.

Huang Qin
4.5g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood, stops bleeding and calms ascending Liver Yang.
With Chai Hu, for Heat in the Shao Yang with alternating chills and fever, and nausea.
Sm. Trichosanthis
Gua Lou Ren
15g
Clears Heat, transforms Hot Phlegm and expands the chest.
With Jiang Ban Xia, Huang Qin, Huang Lian and Chai Hu, for cough with chest pain and difficult to expectorate sputum with extreme Heat.
Fr. Aurantii
Zhi Ke
4.5g
Promotes the movement of Qi, reduces distention and pressure and r esolves hardenings .

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Bupleuri
Chai Hu
6-24g
Resolves Shao Yang disorders and reduces fever (harmonizes the Exterior and Interior).
With Huang Qin clears Liver and Gallbladder Heat.
With Zhi Shi , strongly moves Qi .
With Huang Qin and Zhi Ban Xia, for Shao Yang disorders with alternating chills and fever and a sensation of fullness in the hypochondria and chest.
With Bai Shao, for Liver Blood Deficiency with Liver Qi Stagnation and vertigo, dizziness, thoracic and costal pain, and menstrual irregularity due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-12g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood, stops bleeding and calms ascending Liver Yang.
With Bai Shao, for dysenteric disorders with abdominal pain due to Heat entering the Interior.
With Da Huang, for constipation.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
1-9g
Strongly moves Qi , breaks up Qi Stagnation and
reduces distension and fullness in the chest and abdomen .
With Da Huang , drains Heat retained in the interior, constipation and abdominal swelling due to Food Stagnation and Qi Stag-nation and diarrhea, dysentery, and abdominal pain due to Damp-Heat.
With Da Huang and Huang Qin, for dysenteric diarrhea with tenesmus due to Damp-Heat, especially due to Food Stagnation transforming into Damp-Heat.
With Chai Hu, Huang Qin and Zhi Ban Xia, for cholecystitis.
Rx. et Rz. Rhei
Da Huang
1-9g
Drains Stomach and Gallbladder Heat through the stool, transforms Blood Stasis, and facilitates the flow of bile.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
3-15g
Nourishes the Blood, softens the Liver and treats abdominal pain and distension.
With Zhi Shi and Da Huang , treats pain in the abdomen due to Excess.
With Chai Hu, for flank pain due to Liver Qi Stagnation.
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
3-24g
Harmonizes the Middle Jiao and descends rebellious Stomach Qi .
With Sheng Jiang, stops vomiting.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
4-15g
Warms the Middle, s tops vomiting, reduces the toxicity of other herbs and seafood and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Da Zao , alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen, protects Stomach Qi and reduces irritation of the gastrointestinal tract by other herbs.
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
3-12pc
Helps Bai Shao soften the Liver, reduces abdominal spasms, protects the Yin from injury by pathogenic Heat and protects against the harsh properties of Da Huang and Zhi Shi .
With Sheng Jiang , mildly regulates the Ying and Wei and aids the release of pathogens.

This formula shows a notable effect to treat aspirin-and ethanol- induced gastric hemorrhage. Its protective effect is comparable to sucralfate (Carafate), cimetidine (Tagamet) and 16, 16-dimethyl-prostaglandin E2 (DMPGE2)

Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
4-90g
Clears Heat, expels Wind-Dampness, relaxes the sinews, clears Deficiency Heat and resolves Dampness (good for cramps in the limbs).
With Fang Feng, Du Huo and Qiang Huo for Wind-Cold-Damp Bi .
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao , for Blood Deficiency with hemiplegia, especially with excess muscle tension in the upper extremities.

Gan Cao
2-60g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi clears Heat, moderates spasms, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of the other herbs.
With Bai Shao , for abdominal pain, intestinal spasms and spasms of the calf or other muscles.
With Dang Gui for Wind-Damp Invasion blocking the Blood vessels causing pain, numbness and paralysis.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
2-60g
Activates the Blood, regulates Qi , expels Wind-Cold and alleviates pain (good for headaches).
With Dang Gui for Wind-Damp Invasion blocking the Blood vessels causing pain, numbness, and paralysis.
With Sheng Di Huang and Bai Shao, for headache due to Blood Deficiency.
With Xi Xin, for Wind-Cold headaches
and Shao Yin Cold headaches.
With Dang Gui, Shu Di Huang , and Bai Shao, for headache from Blood Deficiency.

Dang Gui
2-60g
Nourishes the Blood, invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and stops pain.
With Bai Shao , regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood and treats Blood Deficiency Heat.
With Gan Cao , moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
With Shu Di Huang, for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and Devastated Blood.
With Chuan Xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the Blood and disperses Blood Stasis.
With Qiang Huo, Chuan Xiong and Qin Jian, for postpartum Bi syndrome.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
2-60g
Nourishes Blood, astringes Yin , soothes Liver, relieves pain and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood.
With Dang Gui and Shu Di Huang , for dizziness, blurred vision and dysmenorrhea due to Blood Deficiency or Stasis.
With Du Huo and Qin Jiao, for chronic Bi Syndrome with injury to Qi and Blood leading to spasms of the extremities.
Hb. cum Rx. Asari
Xi Xin
1-15g
Releases exterior Wind and Cold, disperses internal Cold, warms the Lungs, alleviates pain, disperses and unblocks the Qi of the nasal orifices and circulates water.
With Sheng Di Huang for headache and toothache due to Wind-Heat.
With Chuan Xiong, for Wind-Cold headache, toothache and Bi pain.
With Chuan Xiong and Fang Feng, for Bi syndrome.
With Bai Zhi, for Wind-Cold toothache.
With Qiang Huo and Fang Feng, for Wind-Cold.
With Du Huo, for joint pain due to Wind-Cold-Dampness.
Rz. et Rx. Notopterygii
Qiang Huo
2-30g
Releases the exterior, dispels Wind-Cold-Dampness from the upper Tai Yang , opens the channels, vitalizes vessels, stops pain and guides Qi to the Tai Yang and Du Channels .
With Chuan Xiong for headache and generalized body aches and pains associated with the common cold or painful obstruction.
With Fang Feng for pain due to Wind-Dampness.
With Du Huo , for Wind-Dampness. (Qiang Huo is better for superficial Wind-Dampness and upper extremities and Du Huo is better for deeper Wind-Dampness and lower extremities).
With Bai Zhi for headaches.
With Bai Zhi, Fang Feng, Xi Xin and Chuan Xiong, for Wind-Cold with aversion to Cold, fever, headaches and muscle aches.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
2-30g
Releases the exterior, expels Wind-Cold-Dampness, stops pain, stops spasms and moves Qi
With Qin Jiao, for Wind Dampness Bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to Wind-Dampness in patients with Blood Deficiency.
With Qiang Huo and Dang Gui, for Wind-Cold-Damp Bi.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
2-30g
Clears Lung Heat, drains Fire and dries Dampness.
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
4-60g
Clears Heat, drains Fire, clears excess Heat from the Lungs, and relieves muscles.
With Shu Di Huang, for headache, toothache, and thirst due to raging fire caused by devastated Yin.
With Sheng Di Huang, for Excessive Fire with injured fluids.
Rx. Angelica Dahuricae
Bai Zhi
2-60g
Expels Wind, alleviates pain and headache, and expels Dampness.
With Xi Xin , for Wind-Cold induced headaches, sinus headaches and orbital headaches.
With Chuan Xiong , for headaches.
Rz. Atractylodes Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
2-30g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi , dries Dampness, and stabilizes the exterior.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
2-30g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood and nourishes Yin and Blood.
With Bai Shao , for Blood Deficiency Heat.
With Shu Di Huang , for Heat symptoms due to Yin Deficiency and devastated Blood.
Rx. Rehmanniae Preparata
Shu Di Huang
2-30g
Nourishes Blood and Yin and strengthens Liver and Kidneys.
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao , for dizziness, palpitations, insomnia and menstrual dysfunction due to Blood Deficiency.
Poria
Fu Ling
2-30g
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness, strengthens the Spleen, harmonizes the Middle Jiao , pacifies the Heart, calms the Shen and soothes the nerves.
With Bai Zhu , strengthens the Spleen and resolves Dampness.
Rx. Angelica Pubescentis
Du Huo
2-60g
Releases the exterior, dispels Wind-Cold-Dampness, opens the channels, vitalizes vessels and stops pain.
With Qin Jiao , expels Wind-Cold-Damp, relieves arthralgia and stops pain.
With Xi Xin and Qin Jiao , for Wind-Damp Bi causing numbness, pain and soreness in the neck, back and lower extremities.
With Fang Feng , for numbness in the legs.
With Qiang Huo , for joint pain and numbness

Administer gradually and stop when sweating has begun.
Contraindicated for those with Shao Yin syndrome.
Contraindicated for those with Yang Deficiency.
Contraindicated for those with Windstroke patterns with External Deficiency.

Concurrent use of this formula reduced the adverse effects of interferon in hepatitis C patients.

Zhi Gan Cao
6g

15g

Shi Chang Pu

sections.CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS:
Latent Stage :
Begins about 1 year after infection.
Relapses may occur.
After the second year new lesions are rare.
This stage may last several years or for the remainder of the patient's life.
In untreated cases, about one-third of those infected develop Late-Stage or Tertiary syphilis which may show up after many years.
Tertiary or Late-Stage :
Lesions develop between 3 and 10 years after infection.
The typical lesion is a rubbery,
chronic, localized inflammation characterized by centralized gray-white necrosis, surrounded by granulized tissue.
They increase slowly in size, heal gradually and leave scars.
They may affect an organ or tissue.
Often they occur in Submucosal tissue such as the :
Palate
Nasal septum
Pharynx
Larynx
They lead to tissue degeneration with perforation of the palate, or septum.
They occur in areas with good blood supply such as the :
Leg below the knee
Upper trunk
Face
Scalp
Eyes
Stomach
Lungs
Liver
Testicles

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
6-12g
Dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, descends Qi, stops vomiting and harmonizes the Stomach.
With Chen Pi, for epigastric and abdominal distention or pain due to disharmony of the Stomach Qi and productive cough and a stifling sensation in the chest due to Phlegm-Damp Obstruction or Spleen Qi Deficiency.
With Fu Ling, expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting, hiccups, coughs with clear, profuse Phlegm and loose and watery stools, prevents turbid Phlegm and Dampness from disturbing the Heart with dizziness, palpitations and insomnia and treats Phlegm, thin mucus and turbid Dampness.
With Sheng Jiang, for vomiting due to Cold, thin mucus.
With Ren Shen, for vomiting due to Stomach Deficiency.
With Chen Pi, Fu Ling and Gan Cao , comprises Er Chen Tang .
Exocarpium Citri Reticulatae Rubrum
Ju Hong
6g
Regulates Qi , dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, descends Qi , harmonizes the Middle and regulates the Stomach to treat vomiting, belching and Phlegm-Damp coughs.
With Sheng Jiang , for vomiting and hiccups due to Disharmony of Stomach Qi and Cold-Dampness Obstructing the Middle with nausea and hiccup.
With Zhi Ban Xia , for a stifling sensation in the chest and cough with excessive white, viscous sputum due to Phlegm-Damp Obstruction.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Fu Ling, for cough due to accumulation of Dampness and Phlegm.
With Sheng Jiang, Zhu Ru and Zhi Ban Xia, for nausea and vomiting due to rebellious Stomach Qi.
(Per. Citri Reticulatae)
(Chen Pi)
6g

Poria
Fu Ling
6-15g
Strengthens the Spleen, drains Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm.
With Zhi Ban Xia , expels Phlegm and stops nausea and vomiting.
With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Sheng Jiang , for congested Fluids in the Stomach manifesting as nausea and vomiting.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
6-10g
Regulates and descends Qi , transforms Phlegm and reduces distention.
With Zhu Ru , for Phlegm-Heat obstructing the flow of Qi with focal distention in the chest and epigastrium, hiccup, dry retching, nausea and acid regurgitation and palpitations, irritability, insomnia and emotional problems due to Gallbladder Stagnation with Phlegm Disturbing the Heart.
With Zhu Ru and Dan Nan Xing , strongly disperses and descends stagnant Qi , clears Heat, expels accumulations, dries Dampness and resolves Wind-Phlegm in the channels.
With Ju Hong , strengthens the Middle Jiao .
Caulis Bambusae In Taeniam
Zhu Ru
2.1g
Clears Heat, transforms Hot Phlegm and stops vomiting.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Zhi Shi, for insomnia, palpitations and irritability due to Phlegm Heat leading to Disharmony between the Gallbladder and Stomach with a stifling sensation in the chest and restlessness.
With Chen Pi, Sheng Jiang and Ren Shen, for vomiting or hiccup due to Stomach Deficiency Heat.
With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi, Zhi Shi and Fu Ling, for Gallbladder Fire with Phlegm.
Rz. Arisaematis Preparatum
Zhi Tian Nan Xing
7.5-12g
Dries Dampness and expels Phlegm .
With Zhi Ban Xia, Chen Pi and Zhi Shi , for Phlegm-Dampness Obstruction that will not dissipate with fainting from Wind-stroke, cough with copious sputum, a cold upper back, a stifling sensation in the chest and a thick, gummy nasal discharge.
With Zhi Ban Xia and Shi Chang Pu, for Phlegm turbidity deranging the orifices of the head and veiling them leading to seizures and convulsions.

Harmonizes the Middle Jiao , aromatically opens the Orifices, vaporizes Phlegm, disperses Wind, removes filth and calms the Shen .

Ren Shen

Gan Cao

sections.CONTRAINDICATIONS:
CONTRAINDICATIONS
Contraindicated for those with Wind-Cold with no sweat and internally contracted Phlegm-Heat.
Don't use too long in acute situations.
Contraindicated for those with chronic asthma with Qi Deficiency and a frail pulse.
Use with caution in early stages of a Wind Invasion showing dyspnea with Anhidrosis.
Contraindicated for those with chronic wheezing or cough caused by Lung and Kidney Yin Deficiency.

獨活寄生湯 - angelica, pubescentis and taxillus decoction disperses wind-dampness scatters cold stops bi pain tonifies the kidneys and liver tonifies qi nourishes the blood pharmaceutical latin pin yin dosage actions rx. angelica pubescentis du huo 4.5-15g disperses wind-cold-dampness from the lower jiao , bones and sinews, vitalizes the vessels and alleviates pain. with xi xin, for shao yin headache, with splitting pain that involves the teeth and cheeks due to external wind-cold and joint pain due to wind-cold-dampness with xi xin and qin jiao , for wind-damp bi causing numbness, pain and soreness in the neck, back and lower extremities. with fang feng, for numbness in the legs. hb. cum rx. asari xi xin 1-6g releases exterior wind-cold, disperses internal cold, warms the lungs transforms phlegm and scours wind-dampness from sinews and bones to stop pain. with chuan xiong , for wind-cold headache, toothache and bi pain. with sheng di huang, for a headache and toothache due to wind-heat. with chuan xiong and fang feng, for bi syndrome. with du zhong and sang ji sheng, for chronic low back and knee pain. rx. saposhnikoviae fang feng 3-10g expels wind-cold and dampness and alleviates pain. with qin jiao , for wind-damp bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to wind-dampness in patients with blood deficiency. rx. gentianae macrophyllae qin jiao 3-10g expels wind-dampness and relaxes sinews. hb. taxilli sang ji sheng 4.5-30g expels wind-dampness, strengthens sinews and bones, tonifies liver and kidney yin and nourishes the blood. with du zhong , and niu xi , expels wind-dampness and tonifies the liver and kidneys. with xu duan, dang gui and du zhong, for restless fetus, and back pain due to yin and blood deficiencies. (rx. dipsaci) (xu duan) (4.5-30g) (often substituted for san ji sheng .) (with du zhong , tonifies liver and kidneys, strengthens the lower back and secures the chong and ren channels to treat aching in the lower back and knees, weakness of the legs which makes walking difficult and especially threatened miscarriage due to instability of the chong and ren channels and restless fetus or bleeding during pregnancy accompanied by lower back pain and a sense of dropping in the lower trunk.) cx. eucommiae du zhong 3-12g tonifies the kidneys and liver and strengthens sinews and bones. with xu duan, for fractures. with sang ji sheng, dang gui and chuan xiong, for low back pain during and after menstruation. rx. achyranthis bidentatae niu xi 3-10g invigorates the blood, strengthens the sinews and bones, benefits the joints and nourishes the liver and kidney yin . with sang ji sheng and du zhong , directs the other herbs toward lower extremities. with du zhong, for low back and extremity pain and weakness due to bi pain or kidney deficiency. with sheng di huang, powerfully clears deficiency fire blazing upward with pain and swelling of the gums, epistaxis, hematemesis and other hemorrhage in the upper body and treats diabetes. cx. cinnamomi rou gui 1-6g warms kidneys, strengthens yang , strengthens ming men fire, disperses deep cold, warms and unblocks the channels and vessels to open the lower back and alleviates pain. with ren shen and shu di huang, for palpitations and shortness of breath due to deficiencies of heart and kidneys. with dang gui and chuan xiong, for dysmenorrhea, postpartum abdominal pain or amenorrhea due to deficiency cold of the chong and ren channels. rx. angelica sinensis dang gui 3-10g tonifies, invigorates and harmonizes the blood, disperses cold and alleviates pain. with chuan xiong, harmonizes, nourishes and invigorates the blood, disperses blood stasis and treats abdominal pain. with chuan xiong, sheng di huang and bai shao , nourishes and invigorates the blood. with

sections.CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS:
Acute lower back ache, unrelieved by changing position or stretching
The pain is often accompanied by hypertonicity and a cold sensation in the low back
Wandering pain in the back and leg
Soreness or itching of the throat
Aversion to Wind and Cold
Tight sensation and tender points in the back area
Limitation of movement
When turning from side to side the pain may radiate to the upper back and make turning difficult
Stiffness and spasm of the back muscles
Symptoms are relieved by warmth and exacerbated by Wind-Cold
Fever and chills
Shivering
Stiff neck
Occipital headache
Cough with expectoration of thin, watery
or frothy white sputum
Anhidrosis
No thirst

Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
10g
Releases the exterior, e xpels External Wind, expels Wind-Dampness and al leviates pain .
With Qin Jiao, for Wind Damp Bi with spasms of the tendons or numbness of the limbs and pain due to Wind-Dampness in patients with Blood Deficiency.
With Ma Huang, dispels Wind-Cold from the Exterior.
Rx. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
6g
Induces sweating, releases the exterior, promotes urination, r educes edema and warms and disperses Cold pathogens.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
10g
Tonifies, activates and harmonizes the Blood, regulates the menses, disperses Cold and stops pain due to Blood Stasis.
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
10g
Expels Wind-Dampness, opens the channels and soothes the sinews and collaterals .
Rx. Puerariae
Gen Gen
10g
Discharges Exterior conditions. releases the muscles, especially of the neck and upper back, relieves Heat and generates fluids.
Rx. et Rz. Notopterygii
Qiang Huo
10g
Releases the Exterior, dispels Wind-Cold-Dampness from the upper Tai Yang , opens the channels, vitalizes vessels and stops pain.
With Fang Feng for pain due to Wind- Damp.
Hb. Schizonepetae
Jing Jie
10g
Releases the Exterior, expels Wind, moves Qi , Regulates Blood and reduces swelling.
With Fang Feng , for Exterior excess.
Caulis Spatholobi
Ji Xue Teng
10g
Nourishes and invigorates the Blood, opens the channels and relaxes the sinews - good for numbness, low back pain and knee pain.
Caulis Trachelospermi
Luo Shi Teng
10g
Dispels Wind-Dampness and opens channels.

sections.NOTES: Grind Qing Fen and Qian Dan into fine powders ( Zhu Sha is already powdered) . Heat the sesame oil in a nonmetallic pan until just boiling. Add the beeswax and continue boiling until the yellow froth disappears. Immediately transfer the liquid into a pre-heated amber jar with a lid. Slowly stir in the powders until well mixed. allow to congeal. Apply the ointment to the affected areas. Dry with a hand-held hair dryer to heat the area (medium or low setting) for 10-20 minutes. Do not overheat. Wipe off the ointment with a sterile cotton ball. Apply once daily for four weeks.

Ren Shen

Da Zao
10-30g

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Fr. Trichosanthis
Gua Lou
12-30g
Clears Lung Heat, transforms Hot Phlegm and regulates Qi (unbinds the chest).
With Zhi Ban Xia, for focal distention in the chest and diaphragm due to clumping of Phlegm and Heat leading to Qi Stagnation
and chest Bi due to clumping of sticky, thick and turbid Phlegm.
With Xie Bai and Zhi Ban Xia, for painful obstruction of the chest (Chest Bi ) due to Cold turbidity stagnating in the Upper Jiao .
Bul. Allii Macrostemi
Xie Bai
9-15g
Unblocks the Yang Qi , disperses turbid Phlegm, alleviates pain, disperses hardenings, descends Qi, reduces Stagnation and disperses Cold Phlegm.
With Gua Lou, for chest Bi with profuse Phlegm.
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
9-12g
Dries Dampness, reduces Stagnation, descends Rebellious Qi and transforms Phlegm.
White wine
Bai Jiu
30-60-ml
sections.FORMULA ACTIONS:
Unblocks the Yang
Disperses Stagnation
Dispels Phlegm
Relieves chest fullness
sections.SYNDROMES: Chest Bi due to Phlegm Stagnation where the pain is so severe that the patient cannot lie down.
sections.CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS:

Dyspnea
Shortness of breath
Severe pain radiating to the back
Severe wheezing
Chest oppression
Severe cough
Disturbed sleep
T: Normal
C: White and greasy
P: Deep and wiry or Tight

Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Fr. Trichosanthis
Gua Lou
3-9g
Clears Lung Heat, transforms Hot Phlegm and unbinds the chest.
Bul. Fritillariae Cirrhosae
Chuan Bei Mu
3-9g
Clears Heat, transforms Phlegm, s tops cough and n ourishes and moistens the Lung .
Per. Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
3-6g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, r elieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm and Descends Qi.
With Zhi Shi and Mu Xiang, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Stagnation.
With Sha Ren, for belching, nausea, and a stifling sensation in the epigastrium due to Disharmony of the Stomach Qi .
Dry-fried Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Chao Zhi Shi
3-6g
Breaks up Stagnant Qi , reduces accumu-lation, descends Qi, u nblocks the bowels Transforms Phlegm and r educes distention .
With Zhi Zi, for a stifling sensation and distention in the epigastrium with feverishness.
With Chen Pi, strengthens the Middle Jiao .
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
3-9g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, benefits the throat and opens and raises Lung Qi , directing the effects of other herbs to the upper body.
With Huang Qin and Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness and pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.

Mu Xiang
2-6g
Promotes the movement of Qi and a lleviates pain.
With Sha Ren, for distention, epigastric and abdominal pain, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dysentery, or tenesmus due to Qi Obstruction and/or Food Stagnation.

Sha Ren

Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
12g
Tonifies Blood, r egulates the menses, reduces swelling, expels pus, generates flesh, alleviates pain, stops coughs and treats dyspnea.
With Huang Qi, for ulcerated abscesses with insufficient drainage or which drain a clear thin discharge
and Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
With Chao Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
With Gan Cao, moderates spasms and relieves abdominal pain.
With Sheng Jiang, Yi Tang, Bai Shao and Gui Zhi, for epigastric and abdominal pain.
With Huang Qi, Bai Shao and Sheng Jiang, for postpartum spontaneous sweating, fever, shortness of breath and back and leg pain with inability to turn from side to side.
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
4.5-12g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, tonifies Wei Qi , stabilizes the exterior, tonifies the Lungs, promotes the discharge of pus, generates flesh and expels toxins.
With Gui Zhi, for Qi and Blood Deficiencies and Ying and Wei Deficiencies with numbness and painful obstruction of the musculature.
With Gui Zhi, Bai Shao, Sheng Jiang and Da Zao, for skin and muscle numbness and pain due to Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
Maltosum
Yi Tang
30g
Tonifies the Spleen and Middle Jiao Qi , alleviates pain, disperses Cold and moderates spasmodic abdominal pain.
With Gui Zhi , warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao .
With Gui Zhi and Gan Cao , for Cold abdominal pain due to Middle Jiao Deficiency.
With Gui Zhi, Bai Shao, Sheng Jiang and Zhi Gan Cao, for abdominal pain that is better with pressure and somewhat alleviated by eating. due to Cold from Middle Jiao Deficiency.
With Dang Gui, for abdominal pain due to Blood Deficiency.
Dry-fried Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Chao Bai Shao
18g
Harmonizes, protects Yin , nourishes Blood, softens the Liver and alleviates pain.
With Gan Cao , stops spasmodic abdominal pain.
With Gui Zhi, Sheng Jiang and Da Zao, for Wind-Cold with Deficiency and perspiration.
With Huang Qi, Gui Zhi, Sheng Jiang and Da Zao, for Bi syndrome.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
6g
Tonifies the Spleen and augments Qi , moistens the Lungs, r esolves Phlegm, s tops cough, moderates spasms, alleviates pain and harmonizes the Middle Jiao .
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
9g
Warms the Middle Jiao , disperses Cold, releases the exterior and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Bai Shao , harmonizes the Ying and Wei .
With Zhi Gan Cao , for Palpitations and shortness of breath due to injured Yang of the chest.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
9g
Releases the exterior, disperses Cold, warms the middle and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects Ying Qi and alleviates epigastric pain, nausea and vomiting, protects the Stomach Qi and reduces irritation of the gastrointestinal. tract by other herbs.
With Gui Zhi, strongly induces sweating for treatment of External Wind-Cold with chills, fever, body aches and anhidrosis and warms and dispels thin mucus in the Stomach with nausea, hiccup, Stomach pain, acid reflux or vomiting of clear fluid.
Fr. Jujube
Da Zao
9g
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi and protects and harmonizes the Middle Jiao .

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
4-12g
Releases the exterior, adjusts the Ying and Wei , warms the channels and collaterals to relieve pain, disperses Cold, unblocks Yang , transforms Qi and releases the muscle layer.
With Bai Shao , harmonizes the Ying and Wei and warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao .
With Zhi Fu Zi , for backache due to Wind-Cold Damp Bi and chills, painful extremities and difficulty in rotating the trunk due to Yang Deficiency with Wind-Cold-Damp Bi .
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
4-10g
Alleviates pain, nourishes the Blood, astringes Yin and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Gui Zhi . harmonizes the Ying and Wei in Tai Yang Zhong Feng .
With Zhi Gan Cao , for muscle spasms, especially in the calf, due to Blood Deficiency.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
3-10g
Helps release the exterior, treats nausea and vomiting, disperses Cold, strengthens the spreading and mobilizing actions of the other herbs and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Zhi Gan Cao , harmonizes and regulates the Spleen and Stomach.
With Da Zao , regulates disharmony between the Ying and Wei . and benefits the Middle Qi .
With Da Zao and Gui Zh i, benefits the Middle Qi , regulates the Ying and Wei , warms the channels and circulates Qi and Blood.
Fr. Zizyphi Jujube
Da Zao
3-12g
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi , nourishes the Blood and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of the other herbs.
With Zhi Gan Cao , tonifies the Middle Jiao and harmonizes.
Fried Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Zhi Gan Cao
2-6g
Alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of the other herbs.
Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
5-10g
Disperses Cold-Dampness, warms the channels and reduces pain.

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
10-30g
Replenishes Qi , stops perspiration, consolidates Wei , strengthens the Spleen and raises Spleen Yang .
With Gui Zhi , for Qi , Blood, Ying and Wei Deficiencies.
Maltosum
Yi Tang
18-30g
Tonifies Spleen and Stomach, alleviates Cold pain and moderates spasmodic abdominal pain.
With Gui Zhi , warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao .
With Gui Zhi and Gan Cao , for Middle Jiao Deficiency Cold with abdominal pain.
With and Huang Qi , for spleen Deficiency.
With Huang Qi, for abdominal pain due to Qi Deficiency.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
4-10g
Warms the Middle Jiao , disperses Cold, releases the exterior, adjusts the Ying and Wei and warms the channels and collaterals to relieve pain .
With Bai Shao , harmonizes the Ying and Wei and warms and tonifies the Middle Jiao .
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
6-20g
Nourishes Blood, regulates menstruation and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Gan Cao , stops spasmodic abdominal pain.
With Yi Tang, Gui Zhi, Sheng Jiang and Gan Cao , for abdominal pain due to Cold from Middle Jiao Deficiency which is better with pressure and somewhat alleviated by eating.
With Huang Qi, Gui Zhi, Sheng Jiang and Da Zao for Bi syndrome.
With Gui Zhi, Yi Tang, Da Zao, Gan Cao and Sheng Jiang, for severe epigastric or abdominal pain or cramps caused by the Liver overacting on the Deficient, Cold Middle Jiao.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3-6g
Tonifies the Spleen, tonifies Qi , moderates spasms. and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
Rz. Zingiberis Recens
Sheng Jiang
2-10g
Releases the exterior, disperses Cold, warms the Middle, s tops vomiting and adjusts the Ying and Wei .
With Da Zao , harmonizes and protects the Ying and Wei .
Fr. Zizyphi Jujube
Da Zao
3-5g
Strengthens the Spleen, tonifies Qi and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
With Sheng Jiang, alleviates epigastric pain, nausea, and vomiting by strengthening the Spleen.

Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Astragali
Huang Qi
15g
Tonifies Qi and Blood, strengthens the Spleen, raises the Yang Qi of the Spleen and Stomach , tonifies Wei Qi , s tabilizes the exterior, tonifies the Lungs, promotes urination and reduces edema.
With Ren Shen, for Qi Deficiency with general debility, anorexia, fatigue, tired extremities and spontaneous sweat.
With Bai Zhu, for Spleen Qi Deficiency with weakness, lassitude and loose stools .
With Mai Men Dong and Wu Wei Zi, for night sweats.
With Sheng Ma, raises Yang Qi of the Spleen, allowing turbid Yin to descend and be eliminated, treating chronic diarrhea, a dragging sensation in the abdomen, fatigue, shortness of breath, uterine bleeding and prolapses.
Rz. Cimicifugae
Sheng Ma
4.5g
Releases the exterior, clears Heat, relieves toxicity, raises Yang and lifts Sunken Qi.
With Dang Gui, raises the clear Qi , allowing turbidity to descend and moistening the Intestines.
Per Citri Reticulatae
Chen Pi
6g
Regulates Qi , adjusts the Middle, r elieves the diaphragm, dries Dampness, transforms Phlegm, descends Qi and helps prevent Stagnation from tonic herbs.
With Bai Zhu, for anorexia and other symptoms of Damp-Obstruction due to Spleen Deficiency.
Rx. Ginseng
Ren Shen
9g
Powerfully tonifies Yuan Qi, tonifies Spleen and Stomach Qi , Lung Qi, Heart Qi and calms the Spirit. Generates Body Fluids, s tops thirst and tonifies Qi in Deficiency patients with Exterior conditions.
With Bai Zhu, tonifies the transformation and transportation functions of the Spleen.
With Huang Qi, for Lung Qi Deficiency.
Rx. Ophiopogonis
Mai Men Dong
12g
Moistens the Lungs, nourishes the Yin, s tops cough , nourishes Stomach Yin, g enerates fluids.
With Ren Shen and Wu Wei Zi, for symptoms associated with excessive loss of fluids in Summerheat disorders and Qi and Yin Deficiencies with fatigue, shortness of breath thirst and dry mouth.
With Huang Qi, Dang Gui and Wu Wei Zi, for irritability due to severe loss of fluids due to sweating.
Rz. Atractylodis Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
9g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi, dries Dampness, promotes water metabolism, stabilizes the exterior and stops sweating.
Rz. Atractylodes
Cang Zhu
9g
Strongly dries Dampness and tonifies the Spleen , i Induces sweating, expels Wind-Dampness and clears Dampness from the Lower Jiao.
With Xiang Fu, for chest, epigastric and abdominal pain, distention and discomfort due to Dampness and Qi Obstruction.
With Huang Bai, for pain, swelling, and weakness of the lower extremities or skin lesions due to Wind-Dampness.
With Bai Zhu, for musculoskeletal disorders of the arms and shoulders due to Phlegm Stagnation.
Cx. Phellodendri
Huang Bai
9g
Drains Damp-Heat especially from the Lower Jiao .
With Zhi Mu, for Lower Jiao Damp-Heat.
With Cang Zhu, eliminates Dampness and clears Heat.
Massa Medicata Fermentata
Shen Qu
3g
Reduces Food Stagnation, promotes digestion, h armonizes the Stomach and moves Qi.
With Bai Zhu, for Food Stagnation and diarrhea due to Spleen Deficiency.
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
9g
Tonifies , invigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold, stops cough and treats dyspnea.
With Huang Qi, for Qi and Blood Deficiencies.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
4.5g
Tonifies the Spleen, augments Qi, moistens the Lungs, resolves Phlegm, stops cough and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
9g
Contains leakage of Lung Qi , stops cough, astringes sweat, g enerates fluids and tonifies Qi .
With Ren Shen and Mai Men Dong, for exhaustion of Qi and Yin with shortness of breath, cough, and thirst
and spontaneous night sweats with Qi Deficiency.
With Huang Qi, for Yang Deficiency with spontaneous sweat.
Rz. Cyperi
Xiang Fu
9g
Spreads and regulates Liver Qi.
Rz. Anemarrhenae
Zhi Mu
9g
Clears Heat from the Qi Stage, from the Lung and from the Stomach , drains Fire , nourishes Yin , moistens Dryness, generates fluids, clears Deficiency Fire, quenches thirst and ameliorates the Dryness of tonifying or warming herbs.

Dosage

Yi Yi Ren

Zhu Ling
9g

Fu Ling and Ze Xie, for edema due to Spleen Deficiency.

Dan Dou Chi
9g
Releases the Exterior, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and relieves stuffy sensations in the chest.
Rz. Alismatis
Ze Xie

Promotes urination and leaches out Dampness .
With Zhi Ban Xia, for turbid Dampness in the Middle Jiao causing epigastric and abdominal distention.
With Fu Ling, for Dampness leading to edema, jaundice, diarrhea, Milky Lin, and scanty, difficult urination with abdominal distention.
With Fu Ling and Zhu Ling, for generalized edema.
Cx. Magnoliae Officinalis
Hou Po
2.4-3g
Promotes the movement of Qi in the Middle Jiao, resolves Stagnation, descends Rebellious Qi , dries Dampness and transforms Phlegm.
Medulla Tetrapanacis
Tong Cao
9-15g
Promotes urination, resolves Dampness and
c lears Heat.

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Flos Magnoliae
Xin Yi Hua
3-9g
Expels Wind-Cold and unblocks nasal passages.
With Xi Xin, lifts and spreads the clear Qi while unblocking the nasal orifices to treat headache and sinus distention, nasal congestion and thick nasal discharge due to Wind-Cold.
With Bai Zhi and Xi Xin, improves the efficacy of Xin Yi.
With Bai Zhi and Fang Feng, for nasal obstruction with clear nasal discharge due to Wind-Cold.
With Cang Er Zi, strongly unblocks nasal obstruction and sinus headache due to Wind-Cold or Wind-Heat for sinusitis and rhinitis with loss of smell.
With Cang Er Zi, Xi Xin and Bai Zhi, for Wind-Cold nasal obstruction and sinus headache with greater effect.
Fr. Xanthii
Cang Er Zi
3-9g
Disperses Wind and Dampness and opens nasal passages.
With Xin Yi, for blocked nose due to Wind-Cold and chronic sinusitis.
With Xin Yi and Bai Zhi, for headache and nasal obstruction.
Rx. et Rz. Ligustici
Gao Ben
3-9g
Expels Wind-Cold, alleviates pain and dispels Wind-Dampness.
With Xi Xin, for Wind-Cold-Damp headache, vertex headaches, stiff neck and toothaches.
With Chuan Xiong and Bai Zhi , accentuates pain relieving effects and are often used together for headaches.
With Chuan Xiong and Xi Xin, for headache due to Cold and Dampness.
Rx. Angelicae Dahuricae
Bai Zhi
3-9g
Expels Wind-Cold, alleviates pain and headache, expels Dampness, alleviates discharge and opens nasal passages.
With Gao Ben, for Wind-Cold induced headaches, especially those at the vertex.
With Xi Xin , for Wind-Cold induced headaches, sinus headaches, orbital headaches and toothache aggravated by cold air.
With Fang Feng and Qiang Huo for Wind-Cold with headache and stuffy nose.
With Gan Cao , for stomachache.
With Chuan Xiong, for headache.
With Cang Er Zi and Xin Yi, for headache due to nasal congestion with thick putrid discharge.
Rz. Cimicifugae
Sheng Ma
3-9g
Releases the exterior., clears Heat. relieves toxicity and raises the Yang .
With Bai Zhi for Yang Ming headache.
Rz. Chuanxiong
Chuan Xiong
3-9g
Activates Blood, regulates Qi , expels Wind-Cold and alleviates pain especially headaches.
With Xi Xin, for Wind-Cold headaches and Shao Yin Cold headaches.
With Xi Xin and Fang Feng, for Wind-Cold Headaches.
With Gao Ben, for severe headache without Interior Fire.
With Fang Feng and Jie Geng, for headache due Wind-Cold Invasion.
Rx. Ephedrae
Ma Huang
3-9g
Induces sweating, releases the exterior, disseminates and facilitates Lung Qi, calms wheezing, stops coughing and warms and disperses Cold pathogens.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
3-9g
Releases the exterior. disperses Cold, expels Wind-Cold-Dampness and alleviates pain.
With Ma Huang, dispels Wind-Cold from the Exterior.
Caul Akebiae
Mu Tong
3-9g
Promotes urination.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae
Gan Cao
3-9g
Resolves Phlegm, stops cough, alleviates pain and moderates and harmonizes the properties of other herbs.
With Jie Geng, for pain and swelling of the throat.
Fol. Camelliae
Lu Cha
3-9g
Dispels Dampness, clears the head and prevents the drying, dispersing and ascending nature of diaphoretic herbs from harming the body.
Fr. Aurantii Immaturus
Zhi Shi
3-9g
Breaks up Stagnant Qi , reduces accumulation, descends Qi, u nblocks the bowels, r emoves stagnant food, transforms Phlegm, r educes distention and r esolves hardenings.
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
3-9g
Warms the Middle, e xpels Cold, warms the Lungs and t ransforms thin mucus.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
3-9g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi, expels Phlegm,benefits the throat and opens and raises Lung Qi , directing the effects of other herbs to the upper body.
With Gan Cao, disseminates Lung Qi, expels Phlegm, resolves toxicity, and expels pus for productive cough with hoarseness, pain and swelling of the throat due to Wind-Heat.
Fr. Schisandrae
Wu Wei Zi
3-9g
Contains leakage of Lung Qi and stops cough.

Zhi Ban Xia
6-10g

Sang Ye

Ju Hua

Chuan Xiong

Gan Cao

Chi Shao

Chai Hu

Fu Ling

records.searchText: jin gui shen qi wan jin gui shen qi wan - 金匱腎氣丸 - kidney qi pills from the golden cabinet (ba wei di huang wan - rehmannia eight formula) shenqiwan https://www.americandragon.com/herb%20formulas%20copy/shenqiwan.html jin gui shen qi wan - 金匱腎氣丸 - kidney qi pills from the golden cabinet (ba wei di huang wan - rehmannia eight formula) warms and tonifies kidney yang pharmaceutical latin pin yin dosage actions rx. rehmanniae preparata shu di huang 8-30g nourishes yin and blood and tonifies the kidneys. with shan zhu yu, nourishes kidney yin and secures jing, while restraining urination and sweating. with rou gui, for kidney yang deficiency . fr. corni shan zhu yu 4-20g nourishes kidney yin and yang , astringes yin and stops excess perspiration. with shan yao , tonifies the liver and benefits the spleen. rx. dioscoreae shan yao 4-15g strengthens the spleen, stabilizes the kidneys and nourishes jing . with shu di huang and shan zhu yu , for kidney deficiency with spermatorrhea, dizziness, tinnitus, lower back pain, impotence and night sweats. rx. lateralis aconiti preparata zhi fu zi 1-15g tonifies the ming men , dispels cold, eliminates dampness and tonifies kidney yang . with gui zhi , assists yang and enhances water metabolism. with shu di huang and rou gui, for kidney yang deficiency with waning of ming men fire with aversion to cold, weak and sore back and legs, impotence, and urinary frequency. ram. cinnamomi (jin gui shen qi wan) gui zhi 1-9g warms and tonifies kidney yang and warms and facilitates the flow of qi through the channels and collaterals and blood through the vessels. with mu dan pi , helps move blood to facilitate the flow to the kidneys. with zhi fu zi, for chills, backache and painful extremities due to yang deficiency with wind-cold-damp bi. (cx. cinnamomi) (ba wei di huang wan ) (rou gui) (3-5g) (warms the kidneys, spleen and heart, strengthens yang and ming men fire , disperses deep cold, w arms the channels, u nblocks the channels and vessels, alleviates pain, leads the fire back to its source and assists the generation of qi and blood. ) (with zhi fu zi, powerfully tonifies kidney yang, for kidney yang deficiency with lower back sections.NOTES:
This formula is usually made into a paste or plaster using tea water,
honey, fresh juice from Flos Chrysanthemi Indici Ye Ju Hua ,
sesame oil, wine, petroleum jelly, etc.
For hot swellings it is best with green tea and/or a tea from Flos
Chrysanthemi Indici Ye Ju Hua .
Tea made from Chinese scallions can be used to make a paste for encouraging
the expulsion of pus.
Use yellow wine to soften carbuncles and expel pus
Mix with black vinegar if the infection is deeper.
Sesame oil can be used for burns or lacquer sores or daubed on herpes
sores
If the powder dries on the skin one should spray a bit of warm
water to rehydrate it.
Depending on the type of condition it is recommended to to cover
the head of the sore (e.g. as for boils) so as to help facilitate eruption.

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Rx. Angelicae Sinensis
Dang Gui
3-15g
Tonifies,
i nvigorates and harmonizes the Blood, disperses Cold and regulates the menses.
With Bai Shao, regulates and harmonizes Qi and Blood.
Cx. Cinnamomi
Rou Gui
1.5-5g
Warms the Kidneys, Spleen and Heart and strengthens Yang and Ming Men Fire, alleviates pain and assists in the generation of Qi and Blood .
With Zhi Fu Zi, for Deficiency of Ming Men Fire with impotence or infertility.
With Zhi Fu Zi and Gan Jiang, for a cold, painful abdomen, anorexia and diarrhea due to Kidney and Spleen Yang Deficiency.
Dens Draconis
Long Chi
9-16g
Settles anxiety and calms the Spirit .
Rx. Linderae
Wu Yao
3-10g
Promotes the movement of Qi , a lleviates pain, warms the Kidneys and disperses Cold .
With Rou Gui, for abdominal pain, especially sensations of Cold and pain in the lower abdomen.
With Wu Zhu Yu, for abdominal pain, vomiting, and diarrhea due to Spleen and Kidney Deficiency Cold.
With Dang Gui, disperses Cold and stops pain, for abdominal pain due to External Cold.
With Yi Zhi Ren, warms and contains the Kidney Qi so that it returns to its source and secures the urine to treat Lower Jiao Deficiency Cold with incontinence, urinary frequency or urinary dribbling.
Fr. Alpiniae Oxyphyllae
Yi Zhi Ren
3-10g
Warms the Kidneys, astringes Jing and urine, warms the Spleen, increases the appetite and
s tops diarrhea and salivation.
Cx. Eucommiae
Du Zhong
8-16g
Tonifies the Kidneys and Liver, s trengthens the sinews and bones, aids the smooth flow of Qi and Blood and tonifies Kidney Yang .
Rz. Acori Tatarinowii
Shi Chang Pu
1.5-10g
Transforms turbid Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao , awakens the Spleen and promotes the movement of Qi .
With Fu Shen, for forgetfulness and dulled senses.
Fr. Evodiae
Wu Zhu Yu
1.5-10g
Warms the Middle Jiao , disperses Cold, promotes the movement of Qi and a lleviates pain.
With Gan Jiang, for acid reflux after meals due to Deficiency and Cold in the Stomach.
With Gan Jiang and Zhi Ban Xia, for abdominal pain, vomiting and acid regurgitation due to Stomach Cold.
Poria Pararadicis
Fu Shen
3-9g
Nourishes the Heart and calms the Shen .
Rx. Cyathulae
Chuan Niu Xi
4.5-15g
Invigorates the Blood, dispels
Blood Stasis, unblocks the menses, tonifies the Kidneys and Liver and strengthens the tendons and bones.
Rx. Gentianae Macrophyllae
Qin Jiao
3-12g
Expels Wind-Dampness, opens the channels, soothes the sinews and collaterals and clears Deficiency Heat.
With Dang Gui and Bai Shao, for Blood Deficiency with hemiplegia, especially with excess muscle tension in the upper extremities.
Hb. cum Rx. Asari
Xi Xin
0.5-5g
Disperses Wind-Cold and Internal Cold and alleviates pain.
With Zhi Fu Zi, for Cold damage both Internal and External with aversion to Cold, headache and generalized body aches with aching joints.
With Zhi Fu Zi and Rou Gui , for abdominal pain, coldness of the lower extremities, a pale tongue and no thirst.
Rx. Platycodi
Jie Geng
3-10g
Opens the Lungs, spreads Lung Qi and expels Phlegm.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for coughing due to Wind-Cold Invasion or long-standing Phlegm-Dampness.
Rx. Saposhnikoviae
Fang Feng
3-10g
Expels Wind-Dampness and a lleviates pain .
Rz. Pinelliae Preparatum
Zhi Ban Xia
3-15g
Dries Dampness and transforms Phlegm.
With Xi Xin and Gan Jiang, for vomiting due to Cold with copious, frothy sputum with Cold signs and thin mucus in the Lungs.
With Gan Jiang and Wu Zhu Yu, for vomiting with clear signs of Cold in the Middle Jiao.
Rx. Paeoniae Alba
Bai Shao
5-30g
Nourishes the Blood, astringes Yin, regulates menstruation, softens the Liver and relieves pain.
With Dang Gui, nourishes Yin and Blood.
Rz. Zingiberis
Gan Jiang
3-10g
Warms the Middle, e xpels Cold , dispels Wind-Dampness seeping into the Lower Jiao, rescues Devastated Yang , e xpels Interior Cold , warms the Lungs and t ransforms thin mucus.
With Zhi Fu Zi, warms the Spleen and Kidneys, benefits Yang , and disperses Cold.
With Zhi Ban Xia, for vomiting of saliva or dry heaves due to Cold-induced congested fluids.
Fr. Zanthoxyli
Chuan Jiao
2-7g
Warms the Middle Jiao , disperses Cold, dispels Dampness, relieves diarrhea and alleviates pain .
With Zhi Fu Zi, for Cold-Dampness in either the Middle or Lower Jiao, Kidney Yang Deficiency with Deficiency of Ming Men Fire allowing Cold-Damp to accumulate in the Lower Jiao leading to urinary frequency, cold sweats or spermatorrhea and strengthens the warming effect on the Spleen, for Spleen Yang Deficiency with Cold-Dampness leading to Cold pain in the epigastrium, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea.
With Zhi Fu Zi and Gan Jiang, for diarrhea due to more Cold than Dampness.
Rx. Aconiti Lateralis Preparata
Zhi Fu Zi
1.5-15g
Warms Ming Men Fire and assists Heart, Kidney and Spleen Yang .
With Rou Gui, powerfully tonifies Kidney Yang, for Kidney Yang Deficiency with lower back pain and weakness in the legs and knees.
Concha Ostreae
Mu Li
9-30g
Heavily settles and calms the Spirit .

Activates the Spleen
Dries Dampness
Expels Phlegm
Purges the Lungs
sections.CLINICAL MANIFESTATIONS:
Cough with copious, thin, white, frothy sputum
Chest and diaphragm congestion with full feeling
Dyspnea which is worse when lying down
Panting with rales in the throat
which usually occurs when exposed to Cold
Sometimes asthma
Maybe cold upper back
A greenish-blue, stagnant facial complexion
No thirst or
A preference for warm drinks
Aversion to Cold
Maybe a slight fever
Headache
Itchy throat
Sneezing
Runny nose
Body aches
Maybe itchy skin at the beginning of the acute stage
T: Pink
C: Thick, white and greasy or sticky
P: Slippery or Floating and tight
sections.TREATS:
Bronchial asthma
Dyspnea
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
sections.NOTES: Grind the ingredients into a fine powder and make into pills with honey and fresh ginger juice. Take 6g each morning with a decoction of Rx. Glycyrrhizae Gan Cao and Rz. Zingiberis Recens Sheng Jiang .

Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Fr. Forsythiae
Lian Qiao
6-30g
Clears Heat, especially in the Upper Jiao , relieves toxicity and clears Blood Heat .
With Jin Yin Hua, for initial stage Wind-Heat.
With Zhi Zi, for Heat entering the Pericardium.
With Sheng Di Huang, Xuan Shen and Shi Gao, for Heart Fire.
Fr. Gardeniae
Zhi Zi
3-12g
Clears Heat, reduces Fire, eliminates irritability , drains Damp-Heat, cools the Blood and relieves toxicity.
With Mu Dan Pi, resolves Qi Level Stagnation leading to Heat and Heat in the Blood.
With Hua Shi, for painful urinary dysfunction due to Damp-Heat in the Urinary Bladder.
With Bai Mao Gen, for epistaxis, hematemesis, or hematuria.
With Huang Lian, Huang Qin and Lian Qiao, for boils and carbuncles.
Rx. Scutellariae
Huang Qin
3-18g
Clears Heat, dries Dampness, drains Fire, detoxifies, cools the Blood and stops bleeding.
With Huang Lian, drains pathogenic Heat from the Upper and Middle Jiaos for high fever, redness, swelling and pain of the head and face, dry mouth, parched throat, ulcerations of the mouth and tongue, epistaxis, rashes and irritability in warm-febrile disease.
With Zhi Mu, for acute and chronic Lung Heat cough.
With Huang Lian and Zhi Zi, for acute febrile disease.
With Bai Mao Gen and Sheng Di Huang, for Excess Internal Heat causing reckless Blood.
With Zhi Zi, powerfully clears and drains lurking Heat from the Lungs with fever, fullness in the chest, cough with yellow sputum and epistaxis or hematemesis, treats Damp-Heat and jaundice
and sores due to Heat toxin.

Huang Lian
1.5-10g
Clears Heat, drains Dampness, drains Fire, resolves Fire toxicity, stops bleeding , clears Heart Fire and drains Stomach Fire.
With Huang Qin and Zhi Zi, for high fever, irritability, dry mouth and throat, and dark urine due to Fire Toxin in the three burners.
With Sheng Di Huang, for insomnia and delirium due to unremitting Heat injuring the Ying level.
With Zhi Zi and Shi Gao, for Ying Stage Heat with delirium and loss of consciousness.
With Huang Qin, Jin Yin Hua, Lian Qiao and Zhi Zi, for boils, carbuncles and furuncles.
Gypsum Fibrosum
Shi Gao
15-60g

With Zhi Mu, for high fever from Wind-Heat or Qi Stage Heat or Yang Ming Heat with irritability and extreme thirst.
With Xi Jiao or Shui Niu Jiao, for epidemic Damp-Heat toxin with high fever, loss of consciousness, epistaxis, and rash.
With Sheng Di Huang, for excessive Fire with injured fluids.
With Xuan Shen and Xi Jiao or Shui Niu Jiao, for Heat at the Qi and Blood Stages with skin eruptions and echymosis.
With Sheng Di Huang and Zhi Mu, for Stomach Fire.
With Mu Dan Pi, Sheng Di Huang and Xuan Shen, for Excessive Heat in the Qi and Xue Levels with continuous high fever and maculae.
Talcum
Hua Shi
9-18g
Promotes urination and drains Heat from the Urinary Bladder, expels Damp-Heat, releases Summeheat and resolves Dampness
Hb. Lonicerae
Jin Yin Hua
6-20g
Clears Heat, resolves Fire toxicity, vents and disperses External Wind-Heat and clears Damp-Heat from the Lower Jiao.
With Huang Lian and Huang Qin, for unremitting high fever.
With Huang Qin, for suppurating boils that have not ulcerated, or have ulcerated but are not discharging pus.
With Shi Gao and Zhi Mu, Qi Stage Heat .
with Mu Dan Pi and Sheng Di Huang, for Ying Stage and Xue Stage Heat.

Zhi Mu
6-12g
Clears Heat, drains Fire, clears Heat from the Qi Stage, from the Lungs and from the Stomach, nourishes Yin and moistens Dryness.
With Huang Lian, for Blazing Stomach Fire with intense hunger, dry stools, dry, yellow tongue coat and a slippery rapid pulse.
With Xuan Shen and Sheng Di Huang, for ulcers of the oral cavity.
Flos Carthami
Hong Hua
3-10g
Invigorates the Blood, dispels Blood Stasis, opens the channels and alleviates pain.
Cx. Moutan
Mu Dan Pi
6-12g
Clears Heat, cools and harmonizes the Blood , clears Deficiency Fire, invigorates the Blood and dispels Blood Stasis.
With Sheng Di Huang, for Ying and Xue Stage Heat with a high fever, scarlet tongue, thirst, a rash all over the body, epistaxis and hemoptysis.
Rx. Rehmanniae
Sheng Di Huang
5-30g
Clears Heat, cools the Blood , nourishes Yin , generates fluids, i ncreases saliva and cools Heart Fire .
With Shui Niu Jiao, for rashes due to Blood Heat.
With Xuan Shen and Xi Jiao, for Heat in the Ying Stage.
With Xuan Shen, for Excess or Deficiency Heat patterns and late-stage febrile disease with irritability, thirst and constipation.
With Bai Mao Gen, cools the Blood, draws out toxicity and reduces searing Heat for Ying Stage Heat with fever, thirst, a scarlet tongue and rashes.

Xuan Shen
7-30g

With Mu Dan Pi, for erysipelas and purplish rashes.
With Sheng Di Huang, Xi Jiao and Lian Qiao, for Ying Stage Heat.
With Shi Gao, Xi Jiao and Zhi Mu, for Excess Toxic Heat with maculae and eruptions.
Rz. Imperatae

9-30g

With Shi Gao, for later stage of a Warm febrile disease with remnants of fever, thirst and dark urine, persistent fever from a Warm pathogen disease
and excessive Heat in the summertime with thirst, irritability and darkish urine.
Cornu Rhinoceri
Xi Jiao
1.5-6g

sections.HERBS AND ACTIONS:
Pharmaceutical Latin
Pin Yin
Dosage
Actions
Poria
Fu Ling
6-15g
Strengthens the Spleen, drains Dampness, harmonizes the Middle Jiao and transforms Phlegm.
With Gui Zhi, warms and transforms Fluids, unblocks Yang and promotes urination.
With Bai Zhu, strengthens the Spleen and resolves Dampness.
With Gui Zhi and Bai Zhu, for Dampness Obstruction causing Lin syndrome, edema, heaviness of the body, and irritability.
With Zhi Gan Cao, for Spleen and Heart Deficiency causing facial edema, palpitations, and shortness of breath.
Ram. Cinnamomi
Gui Zhi
4-10g
Warms the Yang , disperses Cold and helps to resolve congested fluids and descends rebellious Qi .
With Zhi Gan Cao, for palpitations and shortness of breath due to injured Yang of the chest.
With Fu Ling, unblocks the Yang and facilitates the removal of congested fluids associated with Yang Deficiency edema.
With Fu Ling, Bi Zhu and Zhi Gan Cao, for Phlegm accumulation with dizziness, fullness in the chest and hypochondrium, vertigo and palpitations.
Rz. Atractylodis Macrocephalae
Bai Zhu
3-12g
Strengthens the transformative and transportive functions of the Spleen and dries Damp.
With Fu Ling and Gui Zhi , for Spleen Deficiency with chest distention and edema.
With Fu Ling and Zhi Gan Cao, for Spleen and Stomach Qi Deficiency.
Rx. Glycyrrhizae Preparata
Zhi Gan Cao
2-6g
Augments Middle Jiao Qi ,resolves Phlegm and strengthens the Spleen and moderates and harmonizes the harsh properties of other herbs.
